description: This file implements a serializer for Pipecat frames using Protocol Buffers, including classes and methods for serializing and deserializing various frame types to and from binary protobuf format.

classes.name: MessageFrame
classes.description: Data class for converting transport messages into Protobuf format, encapsulating JSON-encoded message data.

classes.name: ProtobufFrameSerializer
classes.description: Serializer class for converting Pipecat frames to and from Protocol Buffer binary format, supporting serialization and deserialization of various frame types.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the serializer type, indicating binary serialization format.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a Frame object into Protocol Buffer binary format, wrapping certain frame types into MessageFrame.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes Protocol Buffer binary data into a Frame object, handling different frame types including transport messages.
